title: Smart Travel Assistant - AWS Serverless Architecture
intro: Event-driven corporate travel automation platform running on AWS Serverless (ap-southeast-2 Sydney), Slack Block Kit, and Multimodal Generative AI.

nodes.label: Business Travelers
detail: Uploads boarding passes, requests travel PRs via chat, and confirms itineraries.

nodes.label: Slack Platform
detail: Renders Block Kit preview cards, handles 14-field edit modal forms, and delivers admin alerts.

nodes.label: API Gateway
detail: Terminates HTTPS webhooks, executes routing for /events, /commands, /interactions with sub-100ms ACK.

nodes.label: EventBridge
detail: Triggers daily departure scans at 08:00 AM VN (01:00 UTC) with automated retry.

nodes.label: Slack Handler
detail: Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signatures, normalizes IATA cities/names, coordinates AI OCR, and commits records.

nodes.label: Flight Reminder
detail: Scans upcoming departures within 24h, requests AI travel guides, dispatches alerts, and updates status.

nodes.label: DynamoDB
detail: Stores active bookings, temporary channel drafts (DRAFT#channel_id), and SHA-256 row hashes.

nodes.label: CloudWatch
detail: Collects Lambda execution logs, API request metrics, and system alarms with 14-day retention.

nodes.label: OpenRouter AI
detail: Parses boarding passes and tickets via Vision AI and drafts bespoke luggage checklists.

nodes.label: Google Sheets
detail: Provides business transparency with 23 standardized itinerary columns and audit validation status.

items.text: Traveler uploads flight ticket image in Slack. API Gateway acknowledges under 100ms and triggers async Slack Handler Lambda, which extracts itinerary via OpenRouter NVIDIA Multimodal Vision AI, stages a temporary draft in DynamoDB, and posts an interactive Block Kit preview card.

Traveler can click [Chỉnh sửa] to adjust details in a 14-field Slack modal form, or click [Xác nhận] to commit. The handler dual-writes the record into Amazon DynamoDB and Google Sheets (23 columns) with an idempotent SHA-256 row hash.

Amazon EventBridge triggers Flight Reminder Lambda daily at 08:00 AM VN. It queries DynamoDB for flights departing within 24h, prompts AI for packing tips and destination survival guide, posts alert to #biz-admin-alerts, and marks status SENT on both DynamoDB and Google Sheets.
